entities.name: Grenzo
entities.description: A hunched, hulking goblin with a staff who leads goblin lackeys, breaks into Fimarell's villa and burns it, and is locked out of his dungeons by Marchesa.

entities.name: Daretti
entities.description: A goblin in a mechanical chair, a former Academy supplicant who takes revenge on Zadrous Fimarell for stealing his manuscript.

entities.name: Zadrous Fimarell
entities.description: An old, paranoid former Academy academic who brought cogwork to Paliano and built his career on Daretti's stolen words; he is thrown from his window.

entities.name: Marchesa
entities.description: The new sovereign of Paliano, celebrated at a festival and resented by Grenzo for locking him out of his dungeons.

entities.name: Muzzio
entities.description: An apprentice and academic, now exiled, whom Fimarell dedicated himself to.

entities.name: Alendis
entities.description: A former Academy man who told Daretti the Academy was not ready for a goblin and has apparently joined the Custodi; he is next on Daretti's list.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: The city in political chaos where the Festival of Our Sovereign Lady's Grace is held.

entities.name: Academy
entities.description: The long-considered seat of knowledge and study in Paliano, now dissolved by royal decree.

entities.name: Custodi
entities.description: The ghostly clergy of Paliano, which Alendis apparently joined.

entities.name: Festival of Our Sovereign Lady's Grace
entities.description: A fireworks-filled festival in Paliano declaring the populace's love for Marchesa.

entities.name: Fimarell's villa
entities.description: The home of Zadrous Fimarell, guarded by a sentry, broken into and burned by Grenzo and Daretti.

entities.name: Cogwork
entities.description: Mechanical life and inventions that Paliano outlawed and that Fimarell once helped bring to the city.

events.summary: Paliano celebrates the Festival of Our Sovereign Lady's Grace while a lone sentry guards Fimarell's house.
events.quote: In the distance, the Festival of Our Sovereign Lady's Grace raged.

events.summary: A mob of goblins pelts the sentry with vegetables and a firebomb to draw him from his post.
events.quote: Weapon raised, he raced for them.

events.summary: Grenzo smashes in the villa door with his staff, grumbling that Marchesa locked him out of his dungeons.
events.quote: One sharp thump from his staff and the villa door crashed to the ground.

events.summary: Grenzo's goblins flood into the villa's foyer and start looting.
events.quote: The crowd of goblins flooded into the foyer

events.summary: Upstairs, Fimarell lies awake and recalls his former glory at the Academy, built on one invention and a lot of handshaking, until it all came crashing down (flashback).
events.quote: He was never a genius, he knew that

events.summary: Goblins have overpowered and tied up three city guards beneath a toppled bookshelf.
events.quote: Three city guards lay unconscious on the floor, pinned under a toppled bookshelf.

events.summary: Grenzo smashes Fimarell's desk and says the papers of praise are fuel.
events.quote: This is fuel.

events.summary: Daretti finds blueprints for one of the first cogwork sentries bearing the Academy seal.
events.quote: It's the blueprints for a cogwork sentry.

events.summary: Grenzo tells Daretti the Academy is dead, Muzzio exiled and cogwork outlawed, and urges him to act like a hyena.
events.quote: Well, the academy is dead and Muzzio is exiled.

events.summary: Daretti, stirred, tells Grenzo to burn everything.
events.quote: Burn it. Burn it all. Burn the ashes.

events.summary: Daretti finds yellowed parchment among the papers that tells him it is time for fresher prey.
events.quote: He withdrew some yellowed parchment.

events.summary: At the top of the stairs Daretti forgets his speech and Grenzo prompts him through it.
events.quote: I've forgotten it.

events.summary: Fimarell spots the goblins in the hallway, yells thieves and slams his bedroom door.
events.quote: "Thieves!" Fimarell yelled and slammed the door.

events.summary: Daretti delivers his speech accusing Fimarell of falsehood and deception.
events.quote: And it is the burden of the honest to bring lies to bear and carry the falsifier to justice.

events.summary: Daretti's chair extends mechanical legs and raises him like a spider over Fimarell.
events.quote: Daretti's chair extended its mechanical legs

events.summary: Daretti reveals that Fimarell criticized his words and then took them as his own.
events.quote: You built your career on the back of my words.

events.summary: Daretti gags Fimarell with a page of the stolen manuscript.
events.quote: He balled up the top page of the manuscript and shoved it into Fimarell's mouth.

events.summary: Daretti heaves Fimarell through the window; he falls two stories to the street.
events.quote: Daretti reached under Fimarell's legs and heaved him up and through the window.

events.summary: Grenzo burns the manuscript in a pot and drops burning refuse onto the street.
events.quote: Grenzo dropped the torch after them.

events.summary: Grenzo's minions smash the furniture, pile it with papers and pour oil on it.
events.quote: One poured oil over the pile.

events.summary: Grenzo and Daretti bicker over who is whose protege while the fire takes hold of the villa.
events.quote: The flames caught quickly and the fire crackled, crawling up the walls.

events.summary: Daretti names Alendis, who apparently joined the Custodi, as his next target; Grenzo adds anyone in league with Marchesa.
events.quote: Sounds like the oily bastard joined the Custodi.

events.summary: Grenzo muses that Marchesa once ran in shadows but now locks every door, and proposes crashing all their parties.
events.quote: Now she's got her comfy chair and locks every door at night.

relations.note: They work together and bicker over who leads.
relations.quote: Let's be clear here. You are my enforcer.

relations.note: He throws Fimarell from the window onto the street.
relations.quote: Daretti reached under Fimarell's legs and heaved him up and through the window.

relations.note: Daretti says Fimarell stole his manuscript and career.
relations.quote: How dare you call us thieves, you sham!

relations.note: Grenzo is angry she locked him out of his dungeons and puts her allies on his list.
relations.quote: Well, if that means he's in league with Marchesa, then he's on my list too.

relations.note: Daretti says he apparently joined the Custodi.
relations.quote: Sounds like the oily bastard joined the Custodi.
